intro: Our plan for the new apartment, room by room. These are AI photo renders of the 3D model: the layout and furniture are the plan, small details (books, plants, the view) are the AI's impression.

experiments.title: Dining table + entry corner
experiments.intro: Five tables we're looking at, each with our own 4 charcoal chairs (more guests get folding chairs from storage) and the entry corner (hall stand, shelf column, shoe cubes) in 2-3 colours, seen from the dining corner and from the front door (the whole living room). Real table sizes; a deeper table stays 60 cm from the wall and grows towards the kitchen. Not in the 3D plan: AI photos to judge the vibe. The AI sometimes leaves the shoe cubes or shelf column white. Shops: ACE Milano 160×90 (walnut version skipped: too dark for the house), Deezen PANAMA 180×100, ACE Selina 130×80, Payngo Porto-Erez 120×80, Stock-online Madlen 180×90 (page wouldn't load: drawn from its description).
